nodes.question: When were Zero or Low Emission Zones introduced by some Dutch cities, and why did the national government intervene?
nodes.answer: Zero or Low Emission Zones were introduced in the 2010s by some Dutch cities based on local needs. The national government intervened in 2019 when a national standard was set due to the patchwork of different rules causing inconsistencies.
